## Description

Send sample receipts, tax invoices, credit notes and advance receipts (both countries, A5 + thermal) to a CA and a UAE tax adviser; apply corrections.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Written approval from both advisers is on file (or UAE marked not-in-scope by ADR-002 with plan).
- [ ] **AC2.** Requested changes are implemented and re-approved before R4.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
